what_passed: The auxiliary heads are default-off and absent from normal v3 forward output.
When enabled, delta/event/end-gap logits have expected shapes.
Teacher-forced labels can be derived from existing v3 target fragments and replay state.
Auxiliary loss is finite and produces nonzero gradients for all new heads and the shared decoder path.
Mapper v3 run config accepts the new model/loss knobs.
what_surfaced: The current v3 sequence still includes standalone time-shift rows; the auxiliary labels are only attached to event rows and a sample end row.
This is a plumbing smoke only. It does not prove learnability, rollout behavior, full-dataset label coverage, or target replacement readiness.
The next useful gate is a tiny training run for the auxiliary objective, not direct rollout or default grammar replacement.
